bugs_found.title: Binary SVM score column inversion
bugs_found.description: scores(:,2) from fitPosterior returned P(class=0) instead of P(class=1). The referable probability was inverted, causing AUC=0.2259 (<0.5).
bugs_found.fix: Changed refProb = refScores(:,2) to refProb = refScores(:,1)
bugs_found.impact: AUC corrected from 0.2259 to 0.7741. All other binary metrics unchanged.
bugs_found.root_cause: MATLAB fitPosterior may reverse column order for binary SVM. Column 1 = P(class=0), column 2 = P(class=1) for ClassNames=[0,1].

bugs_found.title: ECOC scores not softmax-normalized
bugs_found.description: prob_level_0 through prob_level_4 contained raw ECOC log-odds scores (sums ~-3.88), not probabilities (should sum to 1).
bugs_found.impact: Row sums now = 1.000000 exactly. Five-class AUC unchanged (0.8095) because perfcurve is rank-invariant.
